name: INSEE Entreprises MCP
author: DavidScanu
description: Look up French businesses by SIREN or SIRET and search by location or activity using INSEE Sirene and the public business-search API.

installation.notes: The README provides the repository clone, uv dependency installation, environment-file setup, Claude Code registration, verification command, and an alternative manual MCP configuration.

configuration.notes: Python 3.12+, uv, auxiliary command-line dependencies, INSEE key acquisition, the required INSEE_API_KEY variable, and the absolute installation-path placeholder are all documented.

tools.notes: All three tools are described with their data sources, filters, and returned information, followed by concrete natural-language prompts for SIREN, name, director, activity, geographic, and advanced searches.

compatibility.notes: The Claude Code registration command explicitly specifies stdio transport, and both Claude Code and Claude Desktop receive concrete command or JSON configuration examples.

license.notes: The project displays an MIT license badge whose link resolves to the complete MIT license terms. Although no repository LICENSE file exists at this commit, the project-specific badge makes the license explicit and the linked terms are accessible.

limitations.notes: Concrete API limits are documented: 30 requests per minute for the INSEE integration environment and seven requests per second for Recherche d'Entreprises. The README also lists several unavailable data relationships and records.
